subject.title: fix(ui): new sessions remember valid workspace and model choices

question: Should the Control UI permanently retain New Session workspace paths, worktree mode, and model/reasoning choices in each browser profile, scoped by Gateway and agent?
rationale: This is a new user-facing persistence behavior rather than a repair to an established stored-preference contract, and the linked request remains explicitly marked for maintainer product review.

options.title: Confirm browser-local preferences
options.body: Approve the per-browser, per-Gateway, per-agent persistence boundary after current-head live proof shows safe restoration and fallback behavior.

options.title: Narrow the retained fields
options.body: Keep only the choices maintainers consider low-risk to retain and remove any workspace or worktree fields that should not persist across drafts.

recommendation.title: Confirm browser-local preferences
recommendation.body: Approve the per-browser, per-Gateway, per-agent persistence boundary after current-head live proof shows safe restoration and fallback behavior.
